description: This file contains a helper module for testing the Kuksa Databroker API, including classes and functions for managing gRPC connections, subscribing to data points, and handling subscription events in a threaded environment.

classes.name: Databroker
classes.description: A class that wraps the gRPC API for the Kuksa Databroker, providing methods for connecting, retrieving metadata, datapoints, and subscribing to data streams.

classes.name: SubscribeRunner
classes.description: A helper class to run subscription requests in a dedicated thread, collecting events over a specified timeout.

methods.name: ConnectedDatabroker
methods.description: Class method to asynchronously create and connect a Databroker instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Databroker with a specified address.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the gRPC channel.

methods.name: __register_datapoints
methods.description: Registers datapoints with the collector stub.

methods.name: __update_datapoints
methods.description: Updates datapoints via the collector stub.

methods.name: __get_datapoints
methods.description: Retrieves datapoints from the broker stub.

methods.name: await_connectivity
methods.description: Waits until the gRPC channel is in READY state or times out.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Requests metadata from the broker, optionally filtered by names.

methods.name: metadata_to_json
methods.description: Converts metadata list to JSON format.

methods.name: datapoint_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a Datapoint object to a dictionary with name, timestamp, value, and type.

methods.name: get_datapoints
methods.description: Retrieves datapoints, initializing metadata if necessary.

methods.name: __initialize_metadata
methods.description: Initializes metadata and IDs for datapoints.

methods.name: __get_or_create_datapoint_id_by_name
methods.description: Gets or creates a datapoint ID by name.

methods.name: register_datapoint
methods.description: Registers a new datapoint with a given name and data type.

methods.name: set_int32_datapoint
methods.description: Sets an int32 datapoint value.

methods.name: set_uint32_datapoint
methods.description: Sets a uint32 datapoint value.

methods.name: set_float_datapoint
methods.description: Sets a float datapoint value.

methods.name: __get_grpc_error
methods.description: Formats gRPC errors into a string message.

methods.name: subscribe_datapoints
methods.description: Subscribes to datapoints matching a query, invoking a callback on new data.

methods.name: __on_subscribe_event
methods.description: Callback function to handle subscription events, printing data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the subscription in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: get_events
methods.description: Stops the thread and returns collected events.

methods.name: get_dp_values
methods.description: Returns a list of datapoint values for a given datapoint name.

methods.name: find_dp_value
methods.description: Finds a datapoint with a specific value, allowing approximate matching for floats.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Joins the thread and stops event collection.

methods.name: __async_handler
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous subscription process, collecting events.

methods.name: __subscibe_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread target function creating an event loop and running subscription.
